correctness.rationale: A face of \(\mathcal M(K_{2,n})\) is characterized completely by the matching constraints and the unique possible directed four-cycle obstruction. Sequential element matching in the order \(X_i,A_i,Y_i,B_i\) is acyclic. The survivor invariant is inductive and yields exactly \(n^2-1\) critical \(n\)-simplices; deleting the augmented empty-face pair leaves one critical \(0\)-simplex. The standalone verifier independently reconstructs the complex and confirms the exact survivor formulas for \(1\le n\le7\), plus Hasse-diagram acyclicity for \(1\le n\le6\). Risk: the finite verifier does not prove the infinite induction, so correctness depends on the stated exhaustive status induction.
